messages:
nina: quick brain dump — RFC follow-up: 'defer heavy attribute joins to ingest' but we need a clear playbook for tombstones, canonicalization, and late-joins/backfills. aim to reduce edge churn and centralize billing canonicalization. reactions?
omar: +1 central canonicalizer. question: how do we surface eventuality to customers? lucy: UI can show provisional vs final; but queries and downstream jobs need deterministic keys. propose adding canonical_version on billing rows.
ben: storage/cost: tombstone retention is key. suggest default 1h, ops can increase per-tenant. tombstones are tiny records: {env_id, billing_key_hash, reason, ts} — in practice we compress and keep in a TTL-optimized table.
paul: compatibility: include client_bucket and client_attempt in envelope so ingest can dedupe and preserve randomness across retries. also include client_sig to prevent spoofing.
ingest-bot: action created: INF-7010 "ingest deferred enrichment playbook" -> tasks: slim-envelope schema, tombstone service, canonicalizer KV snapshots, backfill API, dedupe index.
omar: late-join/backfill flow: allow POST /ingest/backfill and a kafka topic "late-enrich". backfill writer must upsert into authoritative billing and mark entries backfilled=true. downstream dashboards should merge based on backfill flag.
lucy: for tenants wanting full fidelity, provide tenant flag keep_fidelity=true; ingest honors it by bypassing tombstones. record audited reason field.
ben: monitoring: ingest.enrich.provisional_count, ingest.enrich.authoritative_count, enrich.latency.p50/p95, ingest.backfill.rate. alert if authoritative_count / provisional_count < 0.97 over 5m.
paul: security: canonical map updates require RBAC + signed snapshots; logs must not include raw PII.
nina: rollout plan: start with passive dry-run (no writes to billing) for 48h on a small subset, compare provisional vs expected authoritative, then enable backfill for selected tenants behind feature flag. owners: nina->rollout, omar->canonicalizer, ben->tombstone sizing, lucy->UI + metrics. sync Friday 9am to review dry-run metrics. :white_check_mark:
